name: Droid Storage
description:
This suite offers a single room featuring tightly-packed racks suitable for storing and housing a number of Medium droids equal to four times the ship's suite capacity by size, as shown in the **[Starship Size Suite Capacity](#Starship%20Size%20Suite%20Capacity)** table.
Alternatively, this suite can house droids of other sizes. A Huge droid takes up the space of two Large droids, which in turn takes up the place of two Medium droids, and so on.
